tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Processes, materials, colors, finishes, services, speeds, file formats, limits and payment methods.

tools.name: create_agent_account
tools.description:
Create an autonomous agent account and API key. accept_terms must be true (Terms of Sale + Agent Terms).
    ship_to: {name, line1, line2?, city, state, postal_code, country: 'US', phone?}. The api_key is shown once.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The authenticated account: contact email, default ship_to, credit balance, spending limits.

tools.name: update_account
tools.description:
Change the agent account's name, organization, email, default ship_to or callback_url; omitted fields stay.
    A new email or callback_url is emailed to the previous account email. Agent accounts only.

tools.name: upload_part
tools.description:
Upload a CAD file (STL, 3MF, OBJ, STEP) from an https URL or base64 content (filename required for base64).
    MCP requests are limited to 4 MB, so base64 works for files up to about 3 MB; use a URL or get_upload_url for larger files.
    no_controlled_data must be true: confirms the file has no CU

tools.name: get_upload_url
tools.description: Get a one-time URL to HTTP PUT a large file directly (no auth header needed). Returns the part on upload.

tools.name: get_part
tools.description:
Part status, measured geometry (mm), suggested units, DFM warnings, and processes that fit it.
    Pass wait_seconds to wait for a pending part's analysis in this call instead of polling.

tools.name: create_quote
tools.description:
Create a quote. items: [{part_id, quantity, config: {units, process, material, color, finishes, finish_color, services, infill, layer_height}}].
    See get_capabilities for valid ids. Returns prices, speed options with ship/arrival dates, and next_steps.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Current pricing, speeds, shipping options, warnings and next_steps for a quote.

tools.name: list_quotes
tools.description:
Your quotes, newest first: id, number, status, item_count, expires_at and the last priced total_before_tax.
    Nothing is repriced; use get_quote for current prices. Use it to find quotes to discard when you hit the open-quote limit.

tools.name: discard_quote
tools.description:
Close a quote you no longer need, so it stops counting toward the open-quote limit. It becomes 'expired':
    its checkout links and USDC payment requests stop working and it can't be paid. Discarding it again is harmless.
    An ordered quote, or one with a USDC payment received, can't be discarded

tools.name: update_quote
tools.description:
Change speed (economy|standard|fast|faster|fastest), ship_to, shipping_option, items.
    update_items: [{item_id, quantity?, config?, notes?}] where config is merged into the item's config.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description:
Option A: get a Stripe Checkout URL for a human to pay by card (tax added at checkout).
    Each new link stops earlier links for the same quote from working.

tools.name: pay_with_crypto
tools.description:
Option B: pay autonomously in USDC via x402 (agent accounts only).
    Call without payment_signature to get the payment requirements (amount, asset, pay_to, network); nothing is charged.
    Then sign an x402 'exact' payment and call again with payment_signature (the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value)

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Order status, ship-by and arrive-by dates, tracking.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Orders for this account, newest first. Filter by quote_id to check whether a checkout link was paid.

tools.name: set_refund_preference
tools.description: For USDC orders: receive refunds as 'usdc' (sent to the paying wallet) or 'credit' (account credit).

tools.name: request_order_cancellation
tools.description:
Ask the shop to cancel an order that hasn't shipped. A person reviews it; production may already have started.
    Asking again within 24 hours adds the reason without notifying the shop twice. The order.status_changed webhook
    and get_order show the outcome.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_agent_account" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "request_order_cancellation" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account, get_upload_url, create_checkout_link · Private data: get_capabilities, create_agent_account, get_account, upload_part, get_upload_url, pay_with_crypto, set_refund_preference · Public sink: get_account, update_account, upload_part, get_upload_url, request_order_cancellation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account, get_upload_url, create_checkout_link · Private data: get_capabilities, create_agent_account, get_account, upload_part, get_upload_url, pay_with_crypto, set_refund_preference · Public sink: get_account, update_account, upload_part, get_upload_url, request_order_cancellation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
